note: Real documents chaff is run on. Japanese statutes are public domain (Copyright Act of Japan, Article 13). UK Acts are under the Open Government Licence v3.0 (contains public sector information licensed under the OGL, from legislation.gov.uk). Both are committed; anything that may not be redistributed is listed with redistribute: false and only cached locally. Documents of other kinds (source "url") are fetched from a pinned URL: committed under docs/ when their license allows it (redistribute: true), otherwise only the URL is kept and the text goes to the git-ignored .cache/. A source that is not Markdown or plain text names its "format" ("wikitext", "html", "google-patents": a patent page of which only the abstract, description and claims are kept, "kokkai": a meeting from the 国会会議録検索システム API, or "congressional-record": a Congressional Record granule from govinfo) and is stored converted to Markdown.
